title: Who may upload and prepare designs
question: Should collaborators be able to upload, crop and tag sheets and BIM models, or only project admins? Should the Track3D team's review step need its own permission?
context: The role matrix allows design and BIM changes for admins only. The document-management PRD has collaborators cropping and tagging PDF pages, while the hierarchy-design PRD has collaborators only viewing (DSGN-REQ-004).
options: Admins plus a per-project custom role
